# Getting started

Essential information to help you get set up with AniZen.

---

## Installation guide

### Requirements

Before installing **AniZen**, make sure your device meets the following requirements:

- **Android version**: Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher.
- **Architecture**: `arm64-v8a` (standard for most modern Android devices).
- **Storage**: Minimum 150 MB free internal storage for the application.

### Downloading AniZen

1. Visit our [**Releases**](https://github.com/salmanbappi/AniZen/releases) page to get the latest version of **AniZen**.
2. Select the `AniZen-arm64-v8a.apk` package under the latest release assets.
3. Once the download is complete, open the `.apk` file on your device.
4. If prompted, allow installation from unknown sources for your browser or file manager.
5. Follow the on-screen prompts to complete the installation.

> [!NOTE]
> AniZen is installed under the package identifier `app.anizen`. It installs and runs side-by-side with Aniyomi and Anikku without conflicting with existing data.

---

## Adding sources

Once **AniZen** is installed on your device, you can browse content by installing extension repositories:

1. Open **AniZen** and navigate to the **Browse** tab.
2. Select **Extension Repositories** from the top menu or settings.
3. Add your preferred extension repository URL.
4. Browse available extensions under the **Extensions** tab and tap **Install**.

---

## Adding series to your library

After installing your desired extension, follow these steps to add content:

1. Go to the **Browse** tab and select a source.
2. Use the **Popular** or **Latest** listings, or use the search icon in the toolbar.
3. Select the series you want to add to view its details page.
4. Press the **Add to library** button. The series is now added to your **Library** tab!

> [!TIP]
> You can organize your saved titles into custom collapsible categories by navigating to **Settings → Library → Categories**.

---

## Additional setup

### Global search

To search for a title across all installed extensions at once:

1. Navigate to the **Browse** section.
2. Tap the **Global search** icon in the upper toolbar.
3. Type the series name. Results will load concurrently across all active sources.

### Trouble finding a title?

If a search returns no results, consider the following troubleshooting steps:

- Double-check title spelling. Some sources index entries under **Japanese romanized** titles rather than **English** titles.
  > Example: **Boku no Hero Academia** instead of **My Hero Academia**.
- Try searching with fewer keywords or alternate spellings.
  > Example: **3-gatsu no Lion** instead of **Sangatsu no Lion**.
